label: ercot27 ordc structure
definition: ercot 27 ordc-structure-v1 (PROBE, not promoted — keeper stays ercot26 gtc-limits). ercot 26 base + ORDC-era 2023 price-formation structure, zero fitted parameters: (1) published pre-reform ECRS deployment design (P1-LEVEL: no price-based ECRS release 2023-06-10→2024-07-31, at-cap demand step per IMM 2023 SOM; standing VOLL ramp from 2024-08-01 — PUCT rejected NPRR1224's $750 floor; the handoff's recalled $2,000 proxy floor does not exist in any primary source); (2) multi-product AS co-opt; (3) opt-in AS-aware P2 commitment with commitment-state-aware reserve headroom; (4) endogenous storage AS (G5).
